minimal_interface.ordering: C_yx_bottom_up; cell=j*nx+i; node=j*(nx+1)+i; local BL,BR,TR,TL; ux/uy interleaved. Coarse node(j,i) maps to fine node(2*j,2*i), never by padded old index vector.
minimal_interface.identity: Fine geometry_id, descriptor SHA, archive SHA and field SHA must be generated by the existing writer and differ appropriately. Preserve parent raw bytes; reject an existing output directory. New package is self-contained.
